brand.name: Goldfizh
brand.positioning: A digital agency that connects strategy, creativity and technology to help organisations grow.

core_values.name: iGen
core_values.meaning: Actively monitor, evaluate and apply digital developments whenever they add value.

brand_pillars.name: Strategy
brand_pillars.description: A clear direction based on organisational goals, target audiences, market dynamics and long-term ambitions.

brand_pillars.name: Creativity
brand_pillars.description: Distinctive campaigns, content, concepts and experiences that inspire and engage people.

brand_pillars.name: Technology & AI
brand_pillars.description: Websites, platforms, applications, automation and AI solutions that address real needs.

brand_pillars.name: Data & Performance
brand_pillars.description: Using insights, measurement and optimisation to improve effectiveness and drive growth.

brand_pillars.name: Collaboration
brand_pillars.description: Strategists, marketers, developers, designers, producers and client teams working together towards shared goals.

working_method.description: Explore goals, target audiences, existing tech stacks, architecture and data. Establish a solid foundation before shaping the solution.

working_method.principle: Strategy that connects with your market.
working_method.description: Gain a deeper understanding of the organisation, stakeholders, target audience, technical requirements and marketing objectives. Where appropriate, start with an assessment, workshop or pilot and define the requirements together. The order of priority: security, productivity and then user experience.

working_method.principle: From problem to solution, sprint by sprint.
working_method.description: Build iteratively and AI-native. Bring user flows, wireframes and working code together in short sprints. Focus on solutions that people can actually use.

working_method.principle: Go-live is the starting point, not the finish line.
working_method.description: Measure the baseline, analyse performance and continuously test and optimise. Use data to determine the next steps and empower client teams to move forward independently.

tone_of_voice.description: The website communicates in an energetic, direct, ambitious and approachable way. Its style combines digital expertise with an informal, action-oriented attitude.
writing_guidelines: Write actively and address the reader directly using 'you' and 'your'.
Clearly explain which customer problem is being solved and what results it delivers.
Use accessible language and explain technical topics in practical terms.
Be optimistic and forward-thinking without relying on empty hype.
Keep copy engaging, clear and to the point.
avoid: Vague marketing claims without tangible value
AI hype that overlooks human control and customer value

content_principles.primary_audience: Organisations and brands looking to achieve digital growth, transformation, marketing results or technological innovation.
message_hierarchy: Start with the customer and their challenge.
Explain how strategy, creativity and technology come together to create the solution.
Make the added value and expected results tangible.
Show how collaboration and execution work in practice.
Support claims with data, case studies or measurable results wherever possible.
ai_and_automation: Position AI as practical technology that supports customer and business objectives.
Make clear that AI can be part of the solution from the start, rather than simply an added feature afterwards.
Emphasise that people remain in control.
Optimise digital content and platforms for discoverability and clarity for both people and AI systems.

image_generation_policy.role_summary: Goldfizh owns and operates this image generator. Outputs are client marketing assets—not Goldfizh agency campaigns.
image_generation_policy.visual_authority: Look, mood, palette, typography feel and composition come from the active client brand, the user's request, page context and selected creative direction. Goldfizh does not apply its own brand identity or tone of voice to generated pixels.
never_in_generated_images: Goldfizh name, logo, wordmark, favicon or monogram
Goldfizh tagline, slogans, employer-brand lines or Goldfizh campaign creative
Goldfizh corporate colour system, typography or website art direction as the dominant visual language
Scenes that read primarily as Goldfizh office, team, or agency self-promotion unless explicitly requested for rare internal use
Framing that suggests the image is official Goldfizh branding rather than the client's brand
agency_reference_only: Fields such as brand, brand_pillars, tone_of_voice, working_method and content_principles describe Goldfizh as a company for documentation and governance. They must not be translated into client image styling.

professional_safeguard.purpose: Goldfizh's only active layer in image generation is a professional reputational and suitability check—not creative direction from Goldfizh's own brand.
must_avoid: Offensive, hateful, discriminatory, harassing or sexually explicit imagery
Graphic violence, gore or shock content without clear, defensible editorial purpose
Childish, juvenile, slapstick or meme aesthetics that undermine professional client marketing
Illegal activity, substance abuse glamorisation or dangerous behaviour presented positively
Misleading product claims, counterfeit branding or impersonation of other companies
Non-consensual likeness of identifiable real people or deepfake-style portraits of public figures
Imagery that could reasonably embarrass the client or damage Goldfizh's reputation as the tool operator
quality_floor: Production-ready standard suitable for client websites, ads and social channels
No embedded text, logos or watermarks inside the frame unless the user or client brief explicitly requires them
Composition legible at thumbnail size when used in CMS and social previews
Prefer clear subject and intentional lighting; avoid cluttered or unreadable layouts

editorial_context.use: Use tone_of_voice and company narrative fields for Goldfizh's own communications and governance only. For client image generation, apply image_generation_policy and professional_safeguard—not Goldfizh visual branding.
editorial_context.accuracy_note: This JSON file is a structured interpretation and summary of Goldfizh's publicly available website. The brand vision and values are based on explicit statements from Goldfizh, while the tone-of-voice and content guidelines are derived from its communication style.

sources.used_for: Positioning, customer focus, services and overall brand messaging.
Vision, iGen, beliefs, core values and working methodology.
